summary.notes: Bounded exploration across the supplied anomalies, unresolved hooks, and adjacent route logic did not uncover a stronger uncovered path. The unresolved ConnectionNotice AJAX hook is gated by current_user_can('manage_options') and check_ajax_referer() before any transient write or auth-URL generation at src/Admin/Notices/ConnectionNotice.php:45-49 and src/Admin/Notices/ConnectionNotice.php:63-85. The adjacent token write route remains gated by a CSRF secret validated in both ReachRoutes and ReachApiHandler, with no reviewed path exposing that secret to unauthenticated or low-privilege users at src/Api/Routes/ReachRoutes.php:86-89, src/Api/Handlers/ReachApiHandler.php:212-220, and src/Api/ApiKeyManager.php:36-52. AddFormNotice remains the only residual notice-action concern and is already represented by HR-002.
